pool.text: Decree number six initiated the removal of the capital from Lagos to Abuja.
The International Planning Associates was commissioned to produce the Abuja Master Plan.
The foundation of Abuja occurred under the administration of Shehu Shagari.
Abuja officially replaced Lagos as the capital city of Nigeria.
The present democratic dispensation had its origin at Eagle Square.
Millennium Park was officially opened by Queen Elizabeth the Second.
Former FCT minister Nasir Ahmad el Rufai started a demolition campaign.
The Abuja International Trade Fair has been held annually under ACCI auspices.
Construction of the Millennium Tower started before being halted later.
Abuja joined the UNESCO Global Network of Learning Cities.
Abuja light rail opened and became the first rapid transit in Western Africa.
Maitama II District Cadastral Zone was created by the FCT administration.
The light rail system was shut down due to the COVID epidemic.
The urban agglomeration population was estimated at 3770000 residents.
Traffic resumed on the light rail system on 29 May.
